title: `nvs pkg fetch` does not refuse an archive that holds an `nvs.toml`.
text: `nvs pkg pack` and the registry's build refuse the file, but an archive from a mirror or a private registry is not checked on the way in. Closing it refuses the archive, in any case and at any depth, before anything is written under `vendor/` (`rule:packaging/a-package-cannot-reach-its-host`).
